constraints: Keep deterministic Pomodoro behavior independent from Electron and Promethee transport details.
Keep every Promethee interaction behind the typed, versioned adapter and the accepted ADR-0014 external bridge composition.

Read-only rows are limited to tasks, task_projects, and ADR-0013's eight minimal sessions fields; all writes, arbitrary table or content reads, credentials, tokens, cookies, private IPC, and raw-content diagnostics remain prohibited.

Native OS-mediated actions are limited to exact Pause and Resume for the same session on macOS and are never automatically retried; launch first passively refreshes capabilities and, only after onboarding is visible, may automatically invoke the native permission request at most once per process when required; macOS may show the Accessibility prompt/register the app but the user controls final System Settings toggles; Allow is the explicit retry path and phase transitions never request permission; Check again and Settings review remain preflight-only; the Control timer check derives from native-helper Input Events status; the Read timer check and HUD attachment require helper-reported Screen Recording plus a bounded readiness probe through the real /usr/sbin/screencapture with no retained image; Input Events may be skipped for passive use only after screen reading is verified and both automation settings are off; Not now is refused while screen reading is unavailable and otherwise persists both automation settings off without reopening recovery or requesting Input Events on later launches solely for its absence; an observed Screen Recording false-to-true request transition schedules one guarded relaunch that revokes authority, aborts native control and poll rescheduling, performs a bounded preference/task-time checkpoint wait, then invokes app.relaunch and app.exit; initial new installs default Pause on and Resume off; later enabling automation remains explicit; other persisted values remain unchanged; and the environment kill switch overrides both.

Each eligible macOS action performs two direct fresh SQLite session reads and two bounded HUD captures/classifications, with the second immediately before dispatch, and requires exact app/PID/HUD geometry/generation plus matching rendered Pause/Play layout evidence before one CoreGraphics action; Windows V1 has no Promethee automation and fails closed.
Fail closed when protocol, grants, geometry, exclusions, revisions, or platform behavior are unknown.

Keep permission and missing-geometry recovery menus usable as centered current-display surfaces without HUD geometry; return to attached placement only after current safe geometry recovers, and bring the same popup forward on a second application launch.
Keep the real Promethee timer visible and interactive; local surfaces must not intercept its controls or transient Accept surface.
Reset timer restarts only the current local Pomodoro phase at its configured duration and never controls or resets Promethee.
Select French when the primary operating-system language begins with fr and English otherwise until an explicit preference is implemented.

Prepare the public unscoped promethee-pomodoro@1.0.0 npm package for macOS arm64, macOS x64, and passive Windows x64; stable latest publication requires exact manual approval and verified workflow/registry evidence.
Treat install-electron.sh as a secondary macOS source path and defer native installers, Apple Developer ID/notarization, Windows Authenticode, and project-signed delivery.

Treat the macOS installer's post-install Accessibility and ScreenCapture TCC reset for current and retired bundle identifiers as a temporary ad-hoc-cdhash workaround only; it never grants permissions, users must revalidate and regrant after every V1 rebuild or install, and future Apple Developer ID signing is the stable update-identity solution.

The npm name was unclaimed at the 2026-08-26 E404 check; first publication requires separate approval for one short-lived granular-token/2FA bootstrap, registry readback, token revocation, and exact Trusted Publisher setup before later OIDC releases.
Electron is locked at the authorized 43.4.1; local source validation does not establish clean npm installation, running-runtime identity, or Windows support.
Track time only for the selected task while the real Promethee session observation is running; task changes close the previous local interval.

Persist ADR-0019 reporting data only in task-time-v1.json: bounded task/project snapshots and local interval timestamps are allowed, but Promethee session identifiers are never persisted, exposed to the renderer, or exported.

Keep ADR-0019 history to the newest 10000 closed entries and an encoded snapshot strictly below 8 MiB, with deterministic oldest-first eviction; local deletion and CSV export never write to Promethee.
Expose the attached menu as exactly four user-facing tabs: Context, Tasks, History, and Settings.
Skip focus only through the existing bounded Pause authority; skip break locally to Ready; Reset timer remains local and adds no Promethee operation.
Stop tracking by selecting a null task, closing the active local interval, and preserving saved history.
Page history newest-first at 100 entries per request with explicit Load older access; compute today and Monday-based week totals from DST-aware local calendar boundaries.
Preserve corrupt, unsupported-future, or inaccessible task-time ledgers and fail closed rather than overwriting them.
Use adaptive HUD geometry polling: 16 ms during change or recovery, then 100 ms after 750 ms of stability, applying window plans only on geometry change or recovery.
Do not claim installation, publication, signing, or platform support without artifact and runtime evidence.
open_decisions: Clean macOS proof for first launch, denial, revocation, regrant, and application-identity permission changes; target identity; freshness and unknown-state semantics; broader supported-version proof; and independent Windows passive-runtime verification

Prove the host-wired Electron SQLite task/project slice with exact per-version fixtures, renderer isolation, database side-effect freedom, and independent macOS and Windows path/schema/runtime evidence

Prove the host-wired ADR-0013 session observer with an exact synthetic 1.3.29 fixture, lifecycle/freshness cases, and evidence that observations never become acknowledgements or automatic-retry authority

Extend the authorized macOS 1.3.29 same-session focus/pause/short-break/resume/focus evidence through broader reviewed product and platform flows without creating command acknowledgement; add cycle-snapshot lifecycle recovery separately
Real HUD geometry, exclusions, and platform input/z-order proof

Immutable public Git source, authorized matching V1 tag, reviewed npm tarball/GitHub Release, one-time unclaimed-name bootstrap, token revocation, exact Trusted Publisher/environment ownership, protected approval, workflow execution, registry readback, and clean macOS arm64, macOS x64, and Windows x64 candidate installs
Native signing identities and installers for a later release phase
